Salesforce capture, 2026-11-09. The namespace case used an authorized Developer org with the synthetic namespace shown in the rows. The unmanaged control used a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org. The Account field-set metadata and anonymous Apex are in project/. Two field sets were deployed for the namespace case; only CodexC163Capture was deployed for the unmanaged control. The same Apex was executed through anonymous Apex at API 62.0 and 67.0. The outcomes transcribe the JSON emitted by System.debug. Both executions compiled and succeeded in each org. Namespace metadata deletion succeeded after capture. Scratch-org deletion succeeded and a subsequent alias lookup returned NamedOrgNotFoundError.
After the initial cleanup, both field sets were redeployed to the same authorized namespaced org, and project/lookup.apex was run anonymously at both API versions. Each execution compiled and succeeded. The observed lookup and cardinality results are appended in org.tsv. The two field sets have distinct local names; this does not establish collision behavior across namespaces.
The second metadata deletion succeeded; a subsequent API 67.0 anonymous probe found no remaining probe keys.
A synthetic custom object and its field set were then deployed in the same namespaced org. The source is project/custom-lookup.apex and project/force-app/main/default/objects/CodexC163Object__c/. Anonymous execution compiled and succeeded at API 62.0 and 67.0; org.tsv records the observed key and lookup results. The custom object metadata deletion succeeded, and an API 67.0 global-describe lookup subsequently returned false for its qualified name.
The Account field set was redeployed in the namespaced org for mutation probes. The sources remove.apex, put.apex, and clear-state.apex were executed anonymously at 62.0 and 67.0. Remove and put compiled and failed with the exception in org.tsv; clear-state compiled and succeeded with the logged observations. Metadata deletion succeeded and a subsequent probe found no field-set keys. The field set was deployed once more for putall.apex, executed at both APIs, and deleted; a final probe again found no field-set keys. The initial combined mutation source was not used as an oracle because its first read-only exception stopped execution.
For unmanaged mutation controls, a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org was created and the Account field set deployed. The unmanaged-remove.apex, unmanaged-put.apex, unmanaged-putall.apex, and unmanaged-clear-state.apex sources were run anonymously at both APIs. The first three compiled and failed with the recorded exception; the fourth compiled and succeeded. Scratch-org deletion succeeded and a subsequent alias lookup returned NamedOrgNotFoundError.
Named-route capture: the projects in istest/ were deployed, managed to the authorized namespaced org and unmanaged to a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org. Their two versioned test classes per project each passed as individually invoked synchronous Apex tests. Assertions cover key spelling, qualified and mixed-case lookup, rejection controls, clear, and isolation of previously obtained and fresh maps. The namespaced field set and both test classes were deleted; a subsequent field-set probe found no keys and an ApexClass query found zero probe classes. The scratch org was deleted and its alias lookup returned NamedOrgNotFoundError. The first concurrent 62.0 test attempts hit an admin-operation-in-progress error and were retried successfully after the 67.0 tests completed.
